svg.desc: TsaoSciComputation / Computation across scales. / Traceable at every step. / Scientific questions, methods and contracts / Guarded execution, parsing and convergence / Uncertainty, validity domains and review / Local algorithms are testable; external solvers stay EXTERNAL_HOLD / Absolute temperature: preserve the physical boundary; T_K = T_°C + 273.15; This API requires T > 0 K; temperature differences have no offset / Combined standard uncertainty for independent terms; u_c = √(u_stat² + u_model² + u_num²); Statistical, model and numerical terms need evidence; model correlations separately / SYNTHETIC CONCEPT / AI ARTWORK / NOT MEASURED DATA
